title: Perform Find without Set Error Capture
description: Best-practice rule — flags scripts that Perform Find but never Set Error Capture [On]. A "no records" dialog can interrupt the user mid-script.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Without error capture, a failed find shows a modal dialog and derails automation.
rule.remediation: Set Error Capture [On] before the find and handle Get(LastError) explicitly.
